items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: so he took us to Columbia because he was made the head man of our recording production.

ctx.x: ... so when he finished his contract with Mercury, he knew that Mercury was going to discontinue the Latin department; so he took us to Columbia because he was made the head man of our recording production.
Was Noro Morales already with Columbia at the time?
